::: {.callout-note appearance='simple' collapse=true}
## Source

The topics of this chapter follow the course calendar and Kameron Decker Harris's Fall 2026 lecture notes,
which name recurrence relations and order of growth as the topics after recursive algorithms.
One idea comes from those notes:
the running time of a recursive function is the running time of its recursive call plus the work outside it.

Everything else is new:
the exercises, the examples, the algorithms `pal_loop`, `table` and `pairs`, the Racket functions, the theorems and their proofs.
The algorithms `pal` and `root` come from earlier chapters of these notes.
:::
